product_summary: Specialized home financing for agriculturists, planters, horticulturists, dairy farmers, and fish farmers to purchase residential properties in rural or urban areas. Also available to salaried and self-employed individuals.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Stamp duty, regulatory charges, administrative fees at actuals. Senior citizens receive 10% discount on service charges.

collateral_accepted: Agricultural land (for agriculturists, no mandatory mortgage required)
Other collateral as required by bank
documents_required: Identity proof (Passport, Driving License, Voter ID, NREGA card, NPR letter, Aadhaar)
Title documents of agricultural land (for agriculturists)
IT returns for last 2 assessment years with CA attestation (self-employed)
Last 2 years Balance Sheet and P&L with CA attestation (self-employed)
Employment contract/appointment letter (if less than 1 year employment)
key_features: Customized repayment options tailored to requirements
24/7 customer support via chat and WhatsApp
No mandatory agricultural land mortgage for agriculturists
No mandatory ITR requirement for agriculturists
Purchase of under-construction, new, or existing residential properties
Home construction on freehold or leasehold plots
Home renovation and extension financing available
Available for both rural and urban properties
EMI, eligibility, and affordability calculators available
Competitive interest rates benchmarked to policy repo rate
fees_table_raw: Processing: 0.5-1.5% of loan amount or ₹4,000-₹5,000 minimum + taxes. Conversion: 0.5% or ₹3,000 (first) / ₹2,000 (subsequent), minimum. Premature closure: 2% + taxes for fixed rate loans (except own sources). Payment return: ₹450. Property document retention: ₹1,000/month after 2 months from closure. Stamp duty and regulatory charges at actuals. Senior citizens: 10% discount on service charges.
